name: M & B Engineering Ltd
title: M & B Engineering Ltd - 544470 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Order book INR1,083 cr (+35% YoY) and record inflow INR1,539 cr support ~25% FY27 growth, but Q4 EBITDA margin fell to 11.9% from 14% on steel (+20%) and freight shocks, with no margin guidance given.

utilisation.quote: Q4, my Sanand plant would be around 75%. Sanand plant is operating whole year it operated at peak level. And my Cheyyar plant about 52% to 55%.

capex.quote: Our estimated capex for the year is around INR100 crores, reflecting our continued commitment to expanding capability and scale.

triggers.label: Sanand capacity to 92,000 MT
triggers.quote: Once this expansion is completed, total installed capacity at Sanand will increase to 92,000 metric tons per annum.

triggers.label: New orders priced at higher steel
triggers.quote: It will be coming at a higher price, yes.

triggers.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 11.9% vs 14%
triggers.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 11.9% compared to 14% in the corresponding quarter last year.

triggers.label: Pipeline ~INR1,000 cr+
triggers.quote: as of now the pipeline would be in excess of INR1,000 crores.

triggers.label: Q4 volume growth 8% vs 15% plan
triggers.quote: rather than a 15% growth, we got 8% growth. That was the result.

guidance.quote: For FY '27, we remain confident of delivering top-line growth of around 25% year-on-year
we feel that this is a bit premature for us to give any margin guidance for FY26-27
I think we should be doing at least around INR300 crores in this year on the exports as against INR165.
expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY '27

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 11.9% vs 14%
red_flags.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 11.9% compared to 14% in the corresponding quarter last year.

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow negative
red_flags.quote: If I just look at the receivables in the balance sheet, it's up INR47 crores but in the cash flow the number is much higher.

red_flags.label: Order closure slowing in US
red_flags.quote: the closure of the orders or the inquiries is not coming in as quickly as it used to four months back.

evasions.quote: we want to wait and watch for at least one more quarter before which we will give any specific margin guidance.
I did not want to give any margin guidance whether it was for export or domestic
It would be difficult, we'll have to check and get back.
